answer_1.quote: We conduct extensive experiments on WMT14 En-De, WMT14 En-Fr, and Zh-En tasks... BiTIIMT is better than LCDIMT according to both translation quality and human editing costs. ... The proposed BiTIIMT yields a valid output that can be seamlessly filled in the revised translation in an efficient way similar to the standard NMT decoding.
answer_1.outputs: Generated translations (target sentences) with and without constraints

answer_2.quote: We employ BLEU to measure translation quality, and human editing cost to measure efficiency... We measure decoding cost by using the time required to translate the whole test set...

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 200 sentences from the Zh-En test set and then ask two professional human translators to interact with both systems. Translators are asked to do interactions (deletions, revisions, and insertions) multiple times until they get a satisfactory translation.
answer_4.guideline: Translators interact with the systems, performing deletions, revisions, and insertions until a satisfactory translation is achieved; the results are evaluated in terms of BLEU, decoding time cost, editing cost, and number of interaction rounds.
